issues.detail: The Vietnamese text is entirely different from the Hebrew. It speaks of Ê-xê-chia (Hezekiah), Ê-li-a-kim, Sê-ban, and Ê-sai (Isaiah), whereas the Hebrew has Jeremiah (יִרְמְיָהוּ) speaking to all the officials and all the people. The entire content is a different passage (2 Kings 20:5/Isaiah 38:5) rather than Jeremiah 26:12.
The Hebrew content — Jeremiah's statement that Yahweh sent him to prophesy against this house and this city all the words they have heard — is completely absent from the Vietnamese.
The Vietnamese adds content about Hezekiah's illness, healing, and going up to the temple on the third day, which has no basis in the Hebrew verse.
